question: What obligation of transmission must hold for the practice of the soul to be declared as having been told to a specific recipient?
premises: This practice of the soul is stated.
It has been told to you.
inference: The practice of the soul has now been transmitted to Bhairavī.
uncertainties: Full content of the practice not repeated here
plain_english: This practice of the soul has been told to you, and to you, O Bhairavī.
